room_rent.note: Room up to eligible category/Room Rent per Schedule; proportionate deduction if exceeded; varies by variant (A/B) — VERIFY exact category

icu.note: ICU charges covered under inpatient; proportionate deduction not applicable to ICU — VERIFY no separate cap

copayment.note: Only a Voluntary Co-Pay option exists (ProHealth Select (A)); no mandatory inbuilt co-pay

sub_limits.note: Cancer/Oncology, surgeries for non-malignant tumours/cysts etc. capped in benefit grid — VERIFY scope

initial_waiting.note: Excl03; not applicable after 12 months continuous coverage

maternity.note: No inbuilt maternity benefit found; only definition present — VERIFY

cumulative_bonus.note: +5% SI/yr, max 100%; not reduced for future claims. Optional Cumulative Bonus Booster available instead

restoration.note: 100% restoration of opted SI once per Policy Year; not for ₹0.5L/1L SI; not for same illness already claimed

day_care.note: Day care treatment covered per Annexure II list

organ_donor.note: Donor in-patient expenses up to SI

ambulance.note: Road ambulance reimbursement up to limit specified in Schedule — VERIFY ₹ cap

modern_treatments.note: Deep Brain stimulation, Oral chemotherapy, Immunotherapy, Stereotactic radiosurgery, Bronchial Thermoplasty, Stem cell, etc.

consumables.note: Consumables/non-medical items excluded from Associated Medical Expenses — VERIFY for optional rider

global_cover.note: Worldwide Emergency Cover, ProHealth Select (A) optional (D.III.7)

notable_exclusions.display: Standard IRDAI exclusions (Excl01–18); maternity not inbuilt; overseas only via Worldwide Emergency add-on

optional_riders.display: Critical Illness Add-on, Cumulative Bonus Booster, Voluntary Deductible, Voluntary Co-Pay, Worldwide Emergency Cover
